_doc: Per-screen settings for the Rainbow Screen Builder skill. Paths are relative to the repo root. 'gate' = may a NEW level be started for this screen: 'open' only after the user approved the previous screen / batch (CLAUDE.md, USER_R32/R34: never start the next screen before the user approves). The lead flips a gate to 'open' ONLY with the file that records the user's verbatim OK ('gate_evidence'). compare_mask = VALIDATED scenery mask in 412x915 phone pixels (hud_rows; exclusion boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] = Benny + splash); screens without one use analyze_reference.py's estimate (auto:<analysis.json>) after checking its overlay.
